findings.title: Preserve per-key synchronization during index construction
findings.description: Moving the lock to cache assignment allows concurrent searches and watch events to build separate indexes for the same missing key. `searchSupport.getOrCreateIndex` provides no synchronization. An event can update one completed index before another build replaces it, losing the indexed update. Use per-key synchronization covering lookup, construction, and publication; add a concurrent search/watch regression test.

findings.title: Synchronize document counting with cache writes
findings.description: The new startup log calls `TotalDocs()` after starting the event-consumer goroutine. That goroutine can create indexes while Bleve's `TotalDocs` iterates `b.cache` without locking (`bleve.go:144-146`), causing a data race and potentially a concurrent-map-iteration/write crash. Protect iteration with `cacheMu.RLock()` and test concurrent counting and index creation.

findings.title: Retain rejection of requests after shutdown
findings.description: Removing the request-time `Init` checks also removes the shutdown guard: `Stop` sets `initErr`, which those checks previously returned. Authenticated CRUD requests can now continue reaching the backend after shutdown, even though watch delivery has stopped. Replace lazy initialization checks with an explicit lifecycle-state check and test requests after `Stop`.

findings.title: Restore PostgreSQL integration coverage
findings.description: The unconditional PostgreSQL skip disables this integration test locally as well as in Drone. This removes coverage while resource-server startup behavior is changing. Fix the PostgreSQL fixture or isolate the verified CI-specific limitation rather than skipping every PostgreSQL execution.
